caption: This drawing features a detailed depiction of a dark brown wooden clock with decorative finials and columns on each side, standing on a rectangular base with a triangular top section. The clock face is predominantly white with black numbers and hands, encased in a square border with ornate black designs, and the word “Sessions” written in the center. Beneath the clock face is another rectangular section framed in wood, displaying a small oval painting of a white sailing ship with three masts on a blue sea and a yellow background. To the left of the clock, there is an enlarged drawing of the clock face alone, showing the same ornate border, numbers, and “Sessions” text. To the right of the clock, there is an enlarged drawing of the oval ship painting, surrounded by a yellow border. The background of the entire image is a plain beige color. In the bottom right corner, the text "Dorothea Farrington Practice Work 1935" is written in black.
title: Clock, Antique
